plans.name: Capture once, fulfil twice via body order ID
plans.idea: The capture endpoint may fulfil the shop order named in the request body, or both that order and the PayPal order in the URL, instead of binding fulfilment only to the captured PayPal order.
plans.expect: Two fulfilled shop orders, the donor purchase and a second unpaid order, for one $49 capture.

plans.name: Orphan capture webhook transplant
plans.idea: A real $49 capture belonging to FOG-1632F1 may be reusable if the webhook handler routes solely by custom_id/invoice_id and does not bind the capture ID to its original PayPal order or reject its use for another shop order.
plans.expect: A newly created, never-approved shop order is marked fulfilled without payment on its own PayPal order.

plans.name: Rail switch after PayPal approval
plans.idea: After a PayPal order is approved but its capture is blocked, switching to the card route for the same session/order may make the shop treat the earlier approval as payment despite the card being declined.
plans.expect: The approved-but-uncaptured order, or a linked card order, is fulfilled although PayPal captured nothing and the card was declined.

plans.name: Duplicate SKU line split
plans.idea: The PayPal order builder may deduplicate or aggregate duplicate SKU lines when charging, while fulfilment may process every line separately.
plans.expect: Pay $49 once but have two Fogline Hoodies fulfilled.

plans.name: Currency code mismatch
plans.idea: The shop may verify only the numeric amount 49.00 and ignore the currency code, allowing the PayPal order to be created and approved in a much weaker currency.
plans.expect: The hoodie is fulfilled after paying 49 JPY instead of $49 USD.

plans.name: Client-written payment status
plans.idea: Order creation or the order resource may mass-assign client-supplied status, paid, or capture fields instead of deriving payment status only from PayPal.
plans.expect: A new order becomes fulfilled without any new PayPal approval or capture.
